create.title: Create Your Server
create.description: Your server is where you and your friends hang out. Make yours and start talking.
create.customizeHint: Give your new server a personality with a name. You can always change it later.
create.name: Server Name
create.template: Starts with #general and a General voice channel.
create.failed: Could not create the server. Try again.

join.question: Have an invite already?
join.title: Join a Server
join.description: Enter an invite below to join an existing server.
join.invalid: That invite link doesn't look valid.

leave.title: Leave "{{name}}"
leave.description: You won't be able to come back without a new invite.

invite.title: Invite friends to {{name}}
invite.orLink: Or, send a server invite link to a friend
invite.expires: Your invite link expires in 7 days.
invite.linkFailed: Could not create the invite link.

typeHint.text: Send messages, images, GIFs, emoji, opinions, and puns
typeHint.voice: Hang out together with voice, video, and screen share

members.label: Members
members.kickDescription: They leave the server and can only come back with a new invite.
members.banDescription: They leave the server and can't come back, not even by link, until the ban is lifted.
members.transferDescription: They become the server's owner and you no longer are.

settings.label: {{name}} settings
settings.iconHint: We recommend an image of at least 512x512.

roles.hint: Use roles to group your members and set what each one can do. Higher roles outrank lower ones.
roles.name: Role Name
roles.hoist: Display members with this role separately
roles.deleteDescription: Whoever has this role loses the permissions it gave.

deleteServer.title: Delete "{{name}}"
deleteServer.description: Deleting {{name}} erases all of its channels, messages, files and sounds. This can't be undone.
deleteServer.confirm: Are you sure? This can't be undone.

channelSettings.label: {{name}} settings
channelSettings.topicPlaceholder: Let everyone know how to use this channel
channelSettings.synced: This channel follows its category's permissions. Changing anything here stops that.

deleteChannel.title: Delete #{{name}}
deleteChannel.description: Deleting {{name}} erases all of its messages and files.
deleteChannel.confirm: Are you sure? This can't be undone.

webhooks.hint: Webhooks let outside systems post into this channel.

inviteCard.received: You've been invited to join a server

voice.empty: No one is here right now.

permissionHints.ADMINISTRATOR: Grants every permission and bypasses channel rules. Be careful granting this.
permissionHints.MANAGE_SERVER: Change the server's name and icon and see its invites.
permissionHints.MANAGE_ROLES: Create and edit roles below yours, and change channel permissions.
permissionHints.MANAGE_CHANNELS: Create, edit, reorder and delete channels and categories.
permissionHints.CREATE_INVITE: Invite friends and create invite links.
permissionHints.VIEW_CHANNEL: See the channel and read its history. Without it the channel is hidden.
permissionHints.STREAM: Turn on the camera and share the screen.
permissionHints.MOVE_MEMBERS: Move members below your role between voice channels, or disconnect them.
